Description: Kairon AWS: private RDS PostgreSQL identities/state, private S3 proof, ECS, SQS notifications and CloudFront HTTPS. Existing VPC required.

PublicSubnets.Description: At least two public subnets in different availability zones.

PrivateSubnets.Description: At least two private subnets with NAT egress to Supabase and AWS APIs.

CertificateArn.Description: Issued regional ACM certificate for direct ALB HTTPS; unused with UseCloudFront=true.

AppOrigin.Description: Exact HTTPS origin for direct ALB mode; omit with UseCloudFront=true (automatically assigned).

DesiredCount.Description: Zero for infrastructure bootstrap; set to two after pushing an image.

RedisSecretArn.Description: Optional secret JSON with redisUrl; required for production. URL must use rediss://.

NotificationSecretArn.Description: Secret JSON: encryptionKey, vapidPublicKey, vapidPrivateKey, vapidSubject. Required for enabled channels.

SesIdentityName.Description: Verified SES domain or email identity, in this AWS region.

ProvisionRedis.Description: Create a private two-node encrypted Redis. Adds ongoing ElastiCache charges.

UseCloudFront.Description: Use an AWS-assigned cloudfront.net HTTPS hostname and private VPC origin; no registered domain required.

CloudFrontPrefixListId.Description: Regional com.amazonaws.global.cloudfront.origin-facing managed prefix list; deployment helper resolves automatically.

RdsEngineVersion.Description: Helper resolves the AWS default supported PostgreSQL version at bootstrap, then preserves it.

InitialUsersSecretArn.Description: Optional separate secret JSON with users: a JSON string containing administrator-provisioned accounts. Migration task only.

RdsBackupRetentionDays.Description: Automated RDS backup retention in days; free-plan accounts allow fewer than seven

DemoControlsEnabled.Description: Enable the existing authenticated presenter controls on staging only; resetting replaces staging demo progress.

Properties.GroupDescription: Ingress from CloudFront only for private origin, or public HTTPS for custom domain
API ingress only from the ALB; HTTPS egress for Supabase and AWS

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Reuse presenter tools in an authenticated staging API; normal RDS identities remain authoritative.
must: Presenter controls require staging and explicit enablement.
Hosted demo operation changes require dispatcher authorization.

Properties.GroupDescription: Redis TLS ingress from the Kairon application only

FunctionConfig.Comment: Overwrite the trusted WAF client address header

Properties.FunctionCode: function handler(event) { var request = event.request; request.headers['x-kairon-client-ip'] = { value: event.viewer.ip }; return request; }

Properties.GroupDescription: RDS TLS access from ECS only

Properties.Description: Enforce verified TLS for PostgreSQL connections

Assertions.AssertDescription: Production requires a TLS Redis secret.
Email requires a verified SES sender identity.
Direct ALB HTTPS requires CertificateArn and AppOrigin.
Push requires a secret containing VAPID or FCM provider settings.
Demo controls are only allowed in staging; production must set DemoControlsEnabled=false.

ref.has: Staging demo controls and normal RDS authentication
